## 0. Introduction

This report presents a time series analysis of *Aedes albopictus* egg abundance using the **VectAbundance dataset** ([Da Re et al., 2024](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-024-03482-y)). The study focuses on understanding the influence of climatic variables on egg dynamics, model validation, and climate change projections.

The specific objective of this study is to perform a two-stages analysis of the egg abundance temporal series to investigate the effect of lagged temperature and precipitation on egg-abundance analysis, first differentiating each regions and later pooling over the whole dataset.
